title: Kafka Producer

fields.name: aws_msk_iam
fields.description: Enable AWS MSK IAM authentication. Requires Fluent Bit 4.0.4 or later.

fields.name: aws_msk_iam_cluster_arn
fields.description: Full ARN of the MSK cluster used for region extraction. Required when aws_msk_iam is enabled.

fields.name: brokers
fields.description: Single or multiple list of Kafka brokers. For example, 192.168.1.3:9092, 192.168.1.4:9092.

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: Client ID to use when connecting to Kafka.

fields.name: dynamic_topic
fields.description: Adds unknown topics (found in topic_key) to topics. Only a default topic needs to be configured in topics.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify data format. Available formats: avro (requires Avro encoder build option), gelf, json, msgpack, raw.

fields.name: gelf_full_message_key
fields.description: Key to use as the long message for GELF format output.

fields.name: gelf_host_key
fields.description: Key to use as the host for GELF format output.

fields.name: gelf_level_key
fields.description: Key to use as the log level for GELF format output.

fields.name: gelf_short_message_key
fields.description: Key to use as the short message for GELF format output.

fields.name: gelf_timestamp_key
fields.description: Key to use as the timestamp for GELF format output.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Consumer group ID.

fields.name: message_key
fields.description: Optional key to store the message.

fields.name: message_key_field
fields.description: If set, the value of message_key_field in the record will indicate the message key. If not set or not found in the record, message_key is used if set.

fields.name: queue_full_retries
fields.description: Number of local retries to enqueue data when the rdkafka queue is full. The interval between retries is 1 second. Set to 0 for unlimited retries.

fields.name: raw_log_key
fields.description: When using the raw format, the value of raw_log_key in the record is sent to Kafka as the payload.

fields.name: rdkafka.{property}
fields.description: {property} can be any librdkafka property.

fields.name: schema_id
fields.description: Avro schema ID. Requires the Avro encoder build option.

fields.name: schema_str
fields.description: Avro schema string. Requires the Avro encoder build option.

fields.name: timestamp_format
fields.description: Specify the timestamp format. Allowed values: double, iso8601 (seconds precision), iso8601_ns (nanoseconds precision).

fields.name: timestamp_key
fields.description: Key to store the record timestamp.

fields.name: topic_key
fields.description: If multiple topics exist, the value of topic_key in the record indicates the topic to use. If the value isn't present in topics, the first topic in the list is used.

fields.name: topics
fields.description: Single topic or comma-separated list of topics that Fluent Bit will use to send messages to Kafka. If multiple topics are set, the topic_key field in the record selects the topic.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Kafka Producer.
